test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who amongst the following has the Constitutional authority to conduct the audit of the financial transactions of the union and state governments and union territories?
solution:
The correct answer is __**The Comptroller and Auditor General.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Under the Constitution of India and the Act,** it is the obligation of the Comptroller and Auditor General to review and cover the records of the Union Government and of the Governments of each State and Union Territory having a regulative gathering.
